deprecated_flags.download_ltx2_19b: LTX-2 19B is retired. Use download_ltx23 (on by default) or download_ltx25. Models already on your network volume are untouched; they simply stop being downloaded onto new pods.
deprecated_flags.lightweight_fp8: lightweight_fp8 only ever switched the 19B model between full and fp8, and 19B is retired. It now does nothing. LTX-2.3 ships fp8 already.
